definitions.ack: Original SDK success only. Settlement/lookup does not retroactively turn UNKNOWN or committed_unavailable into ACK.
definitions.actual_http_posts: measurements.<phase>.actual_http_posts counts original execute POSTs only; it excludes status controls (eight in load, four in seed_rows) and is not the total HTTP POST count for the phase.
definitions.body_bytes: Captured request and response body bytes; excludes headers, TLS, backend provisioning and AWS billing effects.
definitions.bp: Original SDK rejected outcome joined to its captured HTTP BACKPRESSURE header. HTTP BP observed after an SDK UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN in the disjoint outcome table.
definitions.business_denominator: load offered_transactions counts execute originals only; the eight status controls are separate.
definitions.business_drain_seconds: max(arrivals_finished_ns, last execute call_finished_ns) - phase origin_ns, divided by 1e9. This is observed business-response drain; it is not the entire runner phase, control drain, or diagnostic quiescence duration.
definitions.cbu_aggregate: terminal_counts.committed_unavailable includes both wire COMMITTED_BUT_UNAVAILABLE and committed results unavailable because an original SDK deadline won; the literal wire-code split is not exported.
definitions.child_cpu: wait4 user/system CPU covers each child lifetime. Summing child CPU by role is valid; it does not isolate load CPU or observer CPU.
definitions.groups: Lifecycle selected/consumed slots can include repeated group attempts and are not independent successful transactions. S3 publication sizes are reported separately.
definitions.histograms: Non-cumulative bucket counts at the frozen upper bounds. They do not provide exact p99 durations.
definitions.interval_mean: total_us / completed / 1000 milliseconds. Censored and not_reached are explicit and excluded from this mean. Overlapping lifecycle intervals must not be added.
definitions.latency: scheduled_to_terminal_ms and control_scheduled_to_terminal_ms use observed call_finished after response capture/drain. They are not separately exported pure SDK-terminal latencies.
definitions.load_cost: Every captured S3 attempt and both body directions during load plus drain, including status traffic and failed attempts. Startup, seed bootstrap, seed rows and settlement/final query are also reported separately.
definitions.observer_cpu: Optional first/last original observer utime/stime deltas cover that process observed cell span: runner, proxy and monitoring together. They are not pure load CPU, diagnostic net overhead, or an estimate relative to an unobserved run.
definitions.offer_window_ack: original_ack_within_offer_window uses the original SDK terminal before origin + 32 seconds.
definitions.pairs: Only the oracle predeclared four pair decisions are used: 12 off1/on1, 12 off2/on2, 32 off1/on1, 32 off2/on2. Aggregates cannot replace these decisions.
definitions.resources: Role sampled peaks cover the whole cell. Backend peaks aggregate four concurrent backend processes. These are monitored acceptance observations, not OS hard caps.
definitions.retention: Final retained request identities = originals_verified + 1 DDL identity, derived from the audited committed/cancelled final closure. Final result records include committed rows plus DDL; cancellation barriers are retained identities without result bodies.
definitions.sampling_delay: Actual start-to-start intervals and their excess over the 100 ms target show scheduling/observation delay; they do not measure observer CPU cost by themselves.
definitions.scan_span: Optional envelope completed_ns - monotonic_ns includes lock wait and process/filesystem observation, but excludes final JSON serialization and sample-file appends performed after completed_ns.
definitions.scope: Finite-growth local S3-compatible comparison; AWS Standard, cross-AZ effects, steady state and production SLO remain unproved.
definitions.source: Extraction of the supplied completed audit/controls JSON; not a new correctness or provenance audit.
definitions.storage: All created immutable objects, final live closure and orphans are distinct. GC is disabled; worker identity and mutable HEAD versions are excluded from this immutable-object accounting.
definitions.windows: Each four-second row separates the offered cohort from observed call_finished outcomes in that wall-clock window. These observed-finish ACK counts need not sum to the SDK-terminal offer-window ACK count.
